proposed_widenings.name: block_reanimation
proposed_widenings.justification: Prevents targeted remains from being animated as undead. Distinct from block_targeting (which prevents spells from targeting a creature) and grant_condition_immunity (which covers the 15 SRD conditions, not creature-type transitions). This is a deterministic protection applied to an object/corpse against undead-creation effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target is protected from decay and can't become Undead

proposed_widenings.name: pause_deadline
proposed_widenings.justification: Pauses countdown timers associated with resurrection window mechanics for the spell's duration. Unique effect type with no v4 equivalent — it modifies how other spells' time constraints are calculated rather than applying any direct effect to the target creature. Not expressible as modify_speed, grant_resistance, or any existing numeric-delta atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: days spent under the influence of this spell don't count against the time limit of spells such as Raise Dead

notes: The structural scaffolding fits: spell kind, timed 10-day duration (non-concentration), action-or-ritual casting time, touch range, object attachment (corpse/remains). The ObjectFilter also lacks a 'corpse' or 'remains' discriminant (minor surface_widening), but the blocking two atoms above are the primary gap. 'Protected from decay' is DM-agenda/narrative with no mechanical game state. The two deterministic mechanics — undead-creation blocking and resurrection-deadline pausing — have no v4 atom equivalents.
